claims.statement: The deletion procedure applies to FPT, GHES and GHEC but GHEC IdP-managed enterprise accounts cannot self-delete. GHES users should contact an enterprise owner before deletion.

Before deletion the source requires copying all owned repositories, private forks, wikis, issues and pull requests. Linked backup procedures are not reviewed by this receipt and a copy request is not verified restorable custody.

The warning says GitHub for cloud, or an enterprise owner for GHES, cannot restore content after account deletion. Local policy must not promise rollback based on UI reversibility or administrator access.

The settings includes lead to Account settings, deletion and a confirmation dialog requiring username/email and the prompted phrase. Confirmation UI does not prove ownership continuity, recoverability or applicable approval.

The sentence introducing pre-deletion conditions is not followed by an explicit list in this guide. Separately reviewed DOCS-ACCOUNTMANAGEMENT-5 organization-owner constraints remain necessary; missing procedure detail cannot imply satisfied prerequisites.
The backup and personal-account reference pointers require their own full review. No account, repository or credential is deleted, no confirmation supplied and no custody or rights clearance claimed.
